Vicar of St.

John the Baptist, Hythe

Husband of John Frewen Moor’s aunt, he married (Bradfield 1843) Elizabeth Stevens (b.1802/3), daughter of the Rev.

Henry Stevens, Rector of Bradfield.

Both were apparently dead by 1881? [Moor, Erminois; 1861 census]
